title: Crew Release Ownership
description: Release ownership for Crew. Owns the ship guard, the release ledger, and the post-ship document/canary/retro sessions.

notes.*: Crew validates the concrete Claude Code/gstack/Superpowers host dependencies in its installer/doctor. The GSD capability overlay itself avoids concrete runtime-registry coupling.

crew.ship.owner.description: Canonical ship/PR owner for a GSD-controlled Crew project.

crew.ship.guard_enabled.description: Arm the Claude Code ship-effect guard during GSD ship.

crew.ship.authorization_ttl_seconds.description: Short-lived GSD ship authorization window for protected remote effects.

crew.gstack.post_ship_enabled.description: Run the release-ledger post-ship adapter after GSD creates the PR.

crew.gstack.document_release_mode.description: Whether gstack document-release may run automatically while the GSD-created PR is open.

crew.gstack.document_release_skill_id.description: Exact gstack document-release skill id exposed by the host.

crew.gstack.document_release_allow_versi.description: Allow VERSION to be included in the docs-only post-ship push authorization.

crew.gstack.canary_mode.description: Run canary only when release evidence proves a matching deployment.

crew.gstack.canary_skill_id.description: Exact gstack canary skill id exposed by the host.

crew.gstack.canary_duration.description: Duration passed to gstack canary when monitor-if-deployed mode is used.

crew.gstack.retro_mode.description: Retro is weekly/sprint-oriented; default is manual rather than every PR.

crew.gstack.retro_skill_id.description: Exact gstack retro skill id exposed by the host.

crew.gstack.retro_window.description: Window passed to gstack retro when invoked automatically.
